A FIELD GUIDE TO QUIET METRICS · VOL. 1
Start freePULL
4 · CTA0:36–0:45

The book claps shut on a downbeat — cover swings in from the right — and the coral “Start free” pull-tab slides out of the page block on the last bar.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Spread — two CSS-3D page planes hinged at the gutter, cream stock with a gutter shadow
  • V-fold stand — an upright card that rotates 0→90° off the page; carries a metric or the logo
  • Fold foot — skewed shadow strip at each stand's base that sells the paper hinge
  • Sunburst die-cut — alternating teal-tint / cream rays behind the reveal medallion
  • Strut + flag — a paper strut lifts the anomaly card above the coral bar
  • Pull-tab — the human action and the CTA: coral paper tab that slides out of the page edge

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Page turn — rotateY 0 → −180°, power2.inOut 0.9 s; the page lands flat on the downbeat, so start it 0.9 s early (≈2 beats at 120 BPM)
  • Pop-rise — stands rotateX 90 → 0°, back.out(1.4) 0.45 s, staggered 0.12 s by depth row so each row lands on an eighth note
  • Linkage — the pull-tab's x drives the flag and bar rotation (tab 0→120 px maps to flag 0→90°), easing none — the reader's pull is the rhythm

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Paper engineering feels crafted and trustworthy, and a pop-up is literally “something rising to your attention” — the anomaly pops while everything else stays flat. Risk: text on angled paper shrinks and warps; keep all copy on stands that face camera and on the flat cover.

Adapt to your product: Turn each of your product's screens into one spread and each key card into a stand; the thing your product catches is the stand that pops up in the alert colour, and your main action becomes the pull-tab.
